description: This file defines the code-behind for an AdminLeaderboard page within an online examination system, handling page load, navigation, and session management functionalities.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the AdminLeaderboard ASP.NET page, handling UI interactions and session management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented-out code for database retrieval and data binding.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Leaderboard button; currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handles search action, sets session variable with selected semester; database search code is currently commented out.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to the login page.
